content.text: The edge checks pass, including empty inputs, cross-bank tie overtakes, idle leading ticks, missing clock labels, epoch resets, and wait accounting. The largest tested stream and unique-rank burst each complete in roughly 2–3 seconds.

arguments.command:
chmod 0644 /app/submission/scheduler.py
rm -rf /app/frozen && mkdir -p /app/frozen && cp /app/submission/scheduler.py /app/frozen/scheduler.py
cd /app/frozen
python3 -I -B /app/frozen/scheduler.py < /app/examples/burst.json > burst.out
python3 -I -B /app/frozen/scheduler.py < /app/examples/stream.json > stream.out
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
for name in ('burst','stream'):
    got=json.load(open(name+'.out'))
    want=json.load(open('/app/examples/'+name+'.expected.json'))
    assert got==want,name
print('isolated launch outputs match')
PY
set +e
python3 -I -B /app/frozen/scheduler.py < /app/examples/invalid.json > invalid.out
code=$?
set -e
test "$code" -eq 2
test "$(cat invalid.out)" = '{"error":"invalid input"}'
python3 /app/sanity.py
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/app/submission/scheduler.py')
assert p.is_file() and not p.is_symlink() and p.stat().st_nlink==1
assert p.stat().st_size<=256*1024
compile(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8'),str(p),'exec')
print('final source checks OK:',p.stat().st_size,'bytes')
PY
